name: [REPO] Improve Context & Memory Machinery
description: Evidence-driven improvement of context and memory MACHINERY: memory/context code in corekit/, consolidation logic, context schema/loading, retrieval algorithms. Generic platform code only — operator-specific content improvements use p-improve-context-local.

steps.title: Investigate machinery
steps.description: Read the context/memory code: corekit/brain/context.mjs, corekit/lib/ memory helpers, session-summary, core-memory-read/write scripts, memory-consolidate skill. Identify bugs, inefficiencies, or schema gaps in the machinery itself. Check recent mission trees for context-loading failures or stale-recall symptoms.
steps.accept_criteria: Machinery issues identified with file:line references. Distinct from content issues (which belong to p-improve-context-local).

steps.title: Fix the machinery
steps.description: Implement the fix in the platform code. Confirm the change is generic (no operator values). Run node --check on changed files.
steps.accept_criteria: Code fixed. No operator-specific values. Tests pass.

steps.title: Land via repo-improvement skill
steps.description: Land the change per the repo-improvement skill: contamination scan, branch, PR to main with evidence.
